description: Bridal hair by Alice, from Milan to Nottingham. Trials at the Wilford studio, calm wedding mornings, styles that last until the last dance.

hero.lead: Trusted expertise for a seamless, luxurious wedding morning, with a touch of Italy.

pull.roots: Rooted in Milan, grown in Nottingham, and made to last, like every style Alice creates.

about.sub: Piacere. From the style capital, Milan, to Nottingham.
paragraphs: I’m Alice Paonessa, your local Italian wedding hair expert. I bring a touch of Italian flair to your bridal look, with calm energy and serious hair know-how.
My studio is in Wilford, Nottingham. It’s where your trial happens, where we try, refine and fall in love with your style before the day itself.
I use classic, timeless techniques that enhance your natural beauty, so you look and feel like the very best version of yourself.

journey.title: The consultation
journey.text: Tell me about your dress, your venue and the look you’ve been saving. I’ll guide you towards the style that suits you, and your day.
journey.quote: So quick to respond to messages and guide me through choosing my hairstyle for the big day.

journey.title: Your trial, in Wilford
journey.text: At my studio we create your look together, test it, refine it and photograph it, so the morning holds no surprises.
journey.quote: She recreated the hair style I wanted perfectly for my wedding day.

journey.title: The wedding morning
journey.text: I come to you. Bride, bridesmaids, mums and flower girls, all styled calmly and ready ahead of time, with room to breathe.
journey.quote: 8 different hairstyles achieved, and each one stunning!

journey.title: Until the last dance
journey.text: Styles built to last: through the photos, the speeches, the weather and the dance floor.
journey.quote: It lasted the entire night, even through all the dancing!

reels.text: Robes, pins, a little fizz and a lot of laughing. Moments from Alice’s wedding mornings, as they happened.

reviews.text: From the hair trial appointment to the catch-up messages, to the actual morning of the wedding: Alice was incredible. 8 different hairstyles achieved, and each one stunning!
reviews.name: Sarah, bride

reviews.text: Her expertise meant that all of the bridal party’s hair kept in place despite a late night on the dance floor.
reviews.name: Cathryn, bride

reviews.text: My hair was absolutely beautiful, as were my bridesmaids’, and it lasted the entire night, even through all the dancing!
reviews.name: Danielle, bride

reviews.text: On the day we battled with rain, wind and even a bit of snow, and all the hair stayed beautiful.
reviews.name: A Bridal Hairstyles bride

reviews.text: She did my hair, my 5 bridesmaids and 2 flower girls, and everyone was thrilled! A wonderful, kind and fun person to have around on your wedding morning.
reviews.name: A Bridal Hairstyles bride

looks_text: Every bride, her own style. Soft romantic updos, polished low buns, glossy Hollywood waves: classic and timeless, made for you.

description: VKX Glam: London hairstylist for brides and occasions. Hollywood waves, half-up glam and modern French twists. DM @vkxglam to book.

hero.lead: Hollywood waves, half-up glam and modern French twists, for London brides and the days that deserve it.

pull.roots: Trained by @senadakxo, styled in London, and planned around you from the first message to the last dance.

about.heading: The hands behind *VKX Glam.*
paragraphs: I create bridal and occasion hair in London: soft Hollywood waves, glossy half-up glam, sleek ponytails and modern takes on the classic French twist.
I trained with @senadakxo and work in collaboration with @glamann.beauty.
Booking is simple. Send me a DM on Instagram with your date and a few inspiration photos, and we’ll plan your look together.

journey.title: Send a DM
journey.text: Message @vkxglam on Instagram with your date, your venue and a few photos you love. I’ll come back to you with availability.

journey.title: Planning your look
journey.text: Waves, half-up, sleek or a sculpted updo: we choose the style together, plus any extensions or accessories it needs.

journey.title: The wedding morning
journey.text: Your hair is styled calmly and carefully on the day, so you can enjoy the morning and feel completely yourself.

journey.title: Until the last dance
journey.text: Glamour that looks as good in the last photo of the night as in the first.
